title: Dua al-Sahar (The Supplication of Glory & Beauty) (Also known as Dua al-Baha)
description: A profound invocation narrated by Imam al-Reda from Imam al-Baqir (a.s.), recited during the pre-dawn hours of Ramadan. It focuses entirely on Divine Attributes and is said to contain the Greatest Name of Allah (Ism Allah al-A'zam).

phrases.arabic: هذا دعاء عظيم المضامين ومبيّن لعظمة صفات اللَّه،
phrases.english: This is a supplication of sublime significance, elucidating the majesty of the Attributes of Allah.
phrases.transliteration: Hādhā du‘ā’un ‘aẓīmu al-maḍāmīni wa-mubayyinun li-‘aẓamati ṣifātillāh.

phrases.arabic: يعين الإنسان على السير والسلوك إلى اللَّه وكماله المعنويّ ويعلّمنا التنبّه لمعانيه معارف التوحيد الخالص.
phrases.english: It assists the human being in the journey and spiritual path toward Allah and his spiritual perfection, and teaches us mindfulness of its meanings: the insights of pure Monotheism.
phrases.transliteration: Yu‘īnu al-insāna ‘alā al-sayri wa-al-sulūki ilā Allāhi wa-kamālihi al-ma‘nawiyyi wa-yu‘allimunā al-tanabbuha li-ma‘ānihi ma‘ārifu al-tawḥīdi al-khāliṣi.

phrases.arabic: وقد روي هذا الدعاء عن الإمام الرضا عليه السلام الذي قال:
phrases.english: This supplication has been narrated on the authority of Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
phrases.transliteration: Wa qad ruwiya hādhā al-du‘ā’ ‘an al-Imām al-Riḍā ‘alayhi al-salām alladhī qāla:

phrases.english: O Allah, make Yourself known to me, for if You do not make Yourself known to me, I shall not know Your Prophet. O Allah, make Your Messenger known to me, for if You do not make Your Messenger known to me, I shall not know Your Proof. O Allah, make Your Proof known to me, for if You do not make Your Proof known to me, I shall stray from my religion.

phrases.arabic: إنَّهُ دعاء الإمام الباقر عليه السلام في أسْحَارِ شَهْرِ رَمَضان وفِيه اسمُ اللَّهِ الأعْظَم والدعاء:
phrases.english: Indeed, this is the supplication of Imam al-Baqir, peace be upon him, for the pre-dawn hours of the month of Ramadan. It contains the Greatest Name of Allah; the supplication is:
phrases.transliteration: Innahu du‘ā’ al-Imām al-Bāqir ‘alayhis-salām fī asḥāri shahri Ramaḍān wa fīhi ism Allāh al-a‘ẓam wa ad-du‘ā’:

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ بَهآئِكَ بِابْهاهُ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You of Your splendor by its most splendid;
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as'aluka min bahā'ika bi-abhāh,

phrases.english: And all Your radiance is radiant,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your radiance in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ جَمالِكَ بِاجْمَلِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You of Your beauty by its most beautiful.
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min jamālika bi-ajmalih,

phrases.english: And all Your beauty is beautiful.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your beauty in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ جَلالِكَ بِاجَلِّهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I ask You of Your majesty at its most majestic,
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min jalālika bi-ajallihi.

phrases.english: And all Your majesty is majestic,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your Majesty in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ بِاعْظَمِها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your grandeur at its most magnificent,
And all Your greatness is magnificent.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your greatness in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسَئَلُكَ مِنْ نُورِكَ بِانْوَرِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You of Your light by its most luminous.
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min nūrika bi-anwarih.

phrases.english: And all Your Light is radiant.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your light in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ بِاوْسَعِها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I ask You of Your mercy by its most expansive,
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka min rahmatika bi-awsa‘iha.

phrases.english: And all Your mercy is vast.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your mercy in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ كَلِماتِكَ بِاتَمِّها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your words, by the most perfect of them.
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min kalimātika bi-atammihā.

phrases.english: And all Your words are perfect.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your words.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ كَمالِكَ بِاكْمَلِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your perfection in its most perfect form,
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min kamālika bi-akmalihi,

phrases.english: And all Your perfection is perfect.
O Allah, I ask of You.
by Your perfection in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ اسمآئِكَ بِاكْبَرِها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I ask You by the greatest of Your Names,
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma innī as’aluka min asmā’ika bi-akbarihā,

phrases.english: And all Your Names are great,
O Allah, I beseech You by all of Your Names.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عِزَّتِكَ باعَزِّها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your Might at its most mighty,
And all Your majesty is majestic,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your might in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ بِامْضاها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I ask You by Your Will at its most decisively executed,
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min mashiyyatika bi-amdhaha.

phrases.english: And all Your Will is effective,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your Will in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِى اسْتَطَلْتَ بِها عَلى كُلِّ شَىْ ءٍ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your power, through that power with which You have dominated all things.
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min qudratika bil-qudratil-latī istatalta bihā ‘alā kulli shay’in.

phrases.english: And all Your power is all-prevailing,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your power in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ بِانْفَذِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your knowledge at its most penetrating,
And all Your knowledge is all-pervading.
O Allah, I beseech You by the whole of Your knowledge.

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ قَوْلِكَ بِارْضاهُ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by the most pleasing of Your words,
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min qawlika bi-arḍāhu,

phrases.english: And all Your words are pleasing,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your Word in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مَسآئِلِكَ بِاحَبِّها الَيْكَ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by the most beloved of Your petitions to You,
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min masā’ilika bi-aḥabbihā ilayk,

phrases.english: And all Your petitions are beloved to You.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your petitions,

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ شَرَفِكَ بِاشْرَفِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You for Your nobility by its most noble part,
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min sharafika bi-ashrafihī,

phrases.english: And all Your nobility is noble,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your nobility in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ سُلْطانِكَ بِادْوَمِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You of Your sovereignty by its most perpetual.
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min sulṭānika bi-adwamihi.

phrases.english: And all Your sovereignty is everlasting.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your sovereignty in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مُلْكِكَ بِافْخَرِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by the most magnificent of Your dominion,
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka min mulkika bi-afkharih.

phrases.english: And all Your sovereignty is magnificent,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your sovereignty in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ عُلُوِّكَ بِاعْلاهُ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I ask You of Your loftiness by its most exalted degree,
And all Your loftiness is lofty,
O Allah, I beseech You by Your sublimity in its entirety.

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ مَنِّكَ بِاقْدَمِهِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You of Your favor by its most ancient.
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka min mannika bi-aqdamihi.

phrases.english: And all Your favor is eternal.
O Allah, I beseech You by Your favor in its entirety,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ مِنْ آياتِكَ بِاكْرَمِها،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by Your signs, through the most noble of them,
phrases.transliteration: Allāhumma innī as’aluka min āyātika bi-akramihā.

phrases.english: And all Your signs are noble.
O Allah, I beseech You by all Your signs,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ بِما انْتَ فيهِ مِنَ الشَّاْنِ وَالْجَبَرُوتِ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by the majesty and the omnipotence in which You dwell.
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka bima anta fihi minash-sha’ni wal-jabarut,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْئَلُكَ بِكُلِّ شَاْنٍ وَحْدَهُ وَجَبَرُوتٍ وَحْدَها،
phrases.english: And I beseech You by every divine state in its uniqueness, and by every supreme power in its uniqueness,
phrases.transliteration: Wa-as’aluka bi-kulli sha’nin waḥdahu wa-jabarūtin waḥdahā,

phrases.arabic: اللهُمَّ انّى اسْئَلُكَ بِما تُجيبُنى [بِهِ حينَ اسْئَلُكَ،
phrases.english: O Allah, I beseech You by that through which You respond to me when I ask of You.
phrases.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka bima tujibuni [bihi hina as’aluka,

phrases.english: So answer me, O Allah.

phrases.arabic: ثمّ سل حاجتك فإنها تقضى إن شاء اللَّه
phrases.english: Then ask for your need, for indeed it shall be granted, if Allah wills.
phrases.transliteration: Thumma sal ḥājataka fa-innahā tuqḍā in shā’ Allāh.
